entries.topic: Carl's reaction to WIN / LOSE / DRAW
entries.answer: WIN: 'That's what I call a thorough beating…' then JUSTIFY/SORRY; LOSE: 'Are your circuits rusty? Or are you just taking pity on an old man?' then LIE/TRUTH; DRAW: 'That is a very odd draw…' then LIE/TRUTH. PowerPyx's paraphrase is outranked
entries.source: template chess PROMPT WIN/LOSE/DRAW with X0101M.LIVING.CHESS.PC.X01MCARL.WIN etc. (rendered outline, Find something to do)
